desc:
PANCAKE MIX AND MORE: Craft deliciously fluffy gluten free pancakes, waffles, or biscuits; An ideal ingredient in gluten free breakfast, dinner, or dessert recipes

GLUTEN FREE VERSATILITY: Make it your go-to gluten free mix for pancakes, waffles, biscuits, and more - so many ways to Bisquick; It's the perfect pantry staple

BETTY CROCKER QUALITY: Made with no preservatives, no artificial flavors, and no artificial colors, so the great taste of your recipes shines through

CUSTOMIZE CREATIONS: Add toppings such as gluten free syrup, whipped cream, chocolate chips, butter, fruit, or whatever you dream up

CONTAINS: One 16 oz box of Betty Crocker Bisquick Gluten Free Pancake and Baking Mix; About 10 servings per package
features:
Features:

Made with roasted peanuts and whole grain oats

Coated in a layer of creamy peanut butter

No artificial flavors, colors, or high-fructose corn syrup

Chewy and crunchy texture in one bite

Individually wrapped for on-the-go convenience

Available in multi-bar packs for easy snacking and sharing

Benefits:

Balanced Flavor: Combines sweet and salty for a satisfying snack

Wholesome Ingredients: Real nuts and grains provide a more nutritious option

Quick Energy Boost: Great for busy days, work breaks, travel, or school lunches

Family Favorite: Enjoyed by both kids and adults

No Junk: Free from artificial additives and preservatives

Easy to Store: Shelf-stable and portable—perfect for lunchboxes or backpacks.
ingredients: Rice Flour, Sugar, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate), Modified Potato Starch, Salt, Xanthan Gum.
